vim9script

# plugins.vim - Asynchronous Vim9 Plugin Manager
var plugin_dir = expand('~/.vim/plugged')

g:plugins = [
      \ 'junegunn/fzf',
      \ 'junegunn/fzf.vim',
      \ 'yegappan/lsp',
      \ 'ojroques/vim-oscyank',
      \ 'itchyny/lightline.vim',
      \ 'elixir-editors/vim-elixir',
      \ 'rust-lang/rust.vim',
      \ 'mhinz/vim-signify',
      \ 'aklt/plantuml-syntax',
      \ 'iamcco/markdown-preview.nvim',
      \ 'eddy147/gemini.vim',
      \ 'catppuccin/vim'
      \ ]

# 1. Startup: Register installed plugins without performing network work.
def EnsurePlugins()
  for repo in g:plugins
    var name = split(repo, '/')[-1]->substitute('\.git$', '', '')
    var path = plugin_dir .. '/' .. name

    if !isdirectory(path)
      echohl WarningMsg
      echom printf('[plugins.vim] Missing %s — run :PluginInstall', repo)
      echohl None
      continue
    endif

    execute 'set runtimepath+=' .. fnameescape(path)
  endfor
enddef

EnsurePlugins()

# 2. Explicitly install any missing plugins.
def InstallMyPlugins()
  if !isdirectory(plugin_dir)
    mkdir(plugin_dir, 'p')
  endif

  for repo in g:plugins
    var name = split(repo, '/')[-1]->substitute('\.git$', '', '')
    var path = plugin_dir .. '/' .. name

    if !isdirectory(path)
      echom printf('[PluginInstall] Cloning %s...', repo)
      system(['git', 'clone', '--depth=1',
            \ 'https://github.com/' .. repo .. '.git', path])
    endif
  endfor

  echom '[PluginInstall] Done. Restart Vim to load newly installed plugins.'
enddef

command! PluginInstall InstallMyPlugins()

# 3. Async parallel updates for installed plugins.
def UpdateMyPlugins()
  var active_jobs = 0
  var total = len(g:plugins)

  echom printf('[PluginUpdate] Starting parallel update for %d plugins...', total)

  for repo in g:plugins
    var name = split(repo, '/')[-1]->substitute('\.git$', '', '')
    var path = $'"{plugin_dir}/{name}"'

    if !isdirectory(expand(path[1 : -2]))
      echom printf('[%s] Not installed.', name)
      continue
    endif

    var cmd = $'git -C {path} pull --ff-only --stat=count'
    active_jobs += 1

    job_start(['sh', '-c', cmd], {
      out_cb: (channel, msg) => {
        var clean_msg = substitute(msg, '[\r\n]\+', ' ', 'g')
        if clean_msg !~# 'Already up-to-date' && !empty(clean_msg)
          echom printf('[%s] Updated: %s', name, clean_msg)

          # Auto-helptags on update
          var doc_dir = expand(path[1 : -2]) .. '/doc'
          if isdirectory(doc_dir)
            execute 'helptags ' .. fnameescape(doc_dir)
          endif

          # Auto-rebuild markdown-preview if updated
          if name ==# 'markdown-preview.nvim'
            echom '[markdown-preview.nvim] Rebuilding app binaries...'
            job_start(['sh', '-c', $'cd {path}/app && ./install.sh'])
          endif
        endif
      },
      exit_cb: (job, status) => {
        active_jobs -= 1
        if active_jobs == 0
          echom '[PluginUpdate] All plugins updated!'
        endif
      }
    })
  endfor
enddef

command! PluginUpdate UpdateMyPlugins()

function! s:GitBlameCurrentLine()
  let l:file = expand('%:p')

  if empty(l:file)
    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'Git blame: no file in current buffer.' | echohl None
    return
  endif

  if !executable('git')
    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'Git blame: `git` is not installed.' | echohl None
    return
  endif

  let l:line = line('.')
  let l:dir = fnamemodify(l:file, ':h')
  let l:name = fnamemodify(l:file, ':t')

  execute '!git -C ' . shellescape(l:dir) . ' blame -L ' . l:line . ',' . l:line . ' -- ' . shellescape(l:name)
endfunction

function! s:PlantumlCommand(file, format, outdir)
  let l:format_flag = ' -t' . a:format
  let l:out_flag = ' -o ' . shellescape(a:outdir)

  if executable('plantuml')
    return 'plantuml' . l:format_flag . l:out_flag . ' ' . shellescape(a:file)
  endif

  if executable('docker')
    let l:dir = fnamemodify(a:file, ':h')
    let l:name = fnamemodify(a:file, ':t')
    return 'docker run --rm -v ' . shellescape(l:dir) . ':/workspace -v /tmp:/tmp -w /workspace plantuml/plantuml' . l:format_flag . l:out_flag . ' ' . shellescape(l:name)
  endif

  return ''
endfunction

function! s:PlantumlExport(format, outdir)
  let l:file = expand('%:p')

  if empty(l:file)
    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'PlantUML: no file in current buffer.' | echohl None
    return ''
  endif

  let l:cmd = s:PlantumlCommand(l:file, a:format, a:outdir)

  if empty(l:cmd)
    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'PlantUML: install `plantuml` or Docker.' | echohl None
    return ''
  endif

  call system(l:cmd)

  if v:shell_error
    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'PlantUML export failed.' | echohl None
    return ''
  endif

  " Path where PlantUML placed the file
  let l:output_file = a:outdir . '/' . fnamemodify(l:file, ':t:r') . '.' . a:format
  echom 'PlantUML exported: ' . l:output_file
  return l:output_file
endfunction

function! s:PlantumlPreview()
  " Export directly to /tmp
  let l:image = s:PlantumlExport('png', '/tmp')

  if empty(l:image) || v:shell_error
    return
  endif

  if !filereadable(l:image)
    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'PlantUML: preview image not found in /tmp.' | echohl None
    return
  endif

  if !executable('xdg-open')
    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'PlantUML: install xdg-open to preview.' | echohl None
    return
  endif

  call system('xdg-open ' . shellescape(l:image) . ' >/dev/null 2>&1 &')
  echom 'PlantUML preview opened: ' . l:image
endfunction

-" Close current buffer
-nnoremap <leader>bd :bdelete<CR>
+" Delete the current buffer without closing windows that display it.
+function! s:DeleteBufferKeepWindows() abort
+  let l:buffer = bufnr('%')
+  if &modified
+    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'Save the buffer before deleting it.' | echohl None
+    return
+  endif
+
+  let l:replacement = bufnr('#')
+  if l:replacement == l:buffer || !buflisted(l:replacement)
+    let l:others = filter(getbufinfo({'buflisted': 1}), 'v:val.bufnr != l:buffer')
+    let l:replacement = empty(l:others) ? bufadd('') : l:others[0].bufnr
+  endif
+  call setbufvar(l:replacement, '&buflisted', 1)
+
+  for l:window in win_findbuf(l:buffer)
+    call win_execute(l:window, 'buffer ' . l:replacement)
+  endfor
+  if bufexists(l:buffer) && empty(win_findbuf(l:buffer))
+    execute 'bdelete ' . l:buffer
+  endif
+endfunction
+
+nnoremap <silent> <leader>bd :call <SID>DeleteBufferKeepWindows()<CR>
